name: Swipe Keyboard (PowOS's keyboard)
purpose: PowOS's default keyboard: the swipe keyboard (com.swipekeyboard; source android-app-dev projects/swipe-keyboard, built and published by `make build PROJECT=swipe-keyboard` to http://android.pow/apk/swipe-keyboard.apk + .ver). The PowOS app (targets/android/app system/DefaultKeyboard.kt) installs it and keeps it at the store's latest build: checked a minute after start and every 6 h, upgrades only, gated (package, advertised version, input method service, signer), the previous APK kept as rollback (files/keyboard/rollback.apk; rooted: rolled back with pm install -d on a failed health check; a failed version is skipped until a newer one). Made the default input method once per phone (rooted: secure settings written; no root: the user is asked once via Android's keyboard settings); a keyboard picked after that stays.
installedBy: the PowOS app (system/DefaultKeyboard.kt): rooted `pm install -i com.powos.app`, no root Android's PackageInstaller
cgroups: uid_<app uid> (Android's own per-app cgroups: ActivityManager places it, lmkd bounds its memory; powos units enforce never moves an Android app)
remove_note: Android falls back to the phone's own keyboard when the default IME is uninstalled; DefaultKeyboard reinstalls it on its next check unless that code is removed too
